## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## 💡 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or user limitation? Please describe.
*Example: As a kirana merchant, I want to export monthly GST tax reports so that I can file returns effortlessly.*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented, including potential frontend UI components, backend endpoints, or database schema additions.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Checklist
- [ ] This feature aligns with the core kirana/grocery focus of Mane Bazar.
- [ ] I am willing to submit a pull request implementing this feature if approved.
